name: Lau ca duoi
summary: Lẩu cá đuối is the stingray pot on the same town menu. Dân Việt lists it with the other fish pots, cooked with vegetables, sour bamboo, cần cà, or ngót. A diner ordered it. The story does not print a broth that belongs only to the ray. Steamed ray with onion is the other plate.
origin: Can Gio. Dân Việt, 2 Oct 2022, on the town menu.
howToEat: Share the pot at lunch or dinner.
The about 280,000–300,000 VND hotpot line in that story is for a portion of lẩu, not labeled as ray alone. A 2026 price is Check on arrival.
where: Đường Duyên Hải and đường Tắc Xuất, xã Cần Giờ. The hour is Check on arrival.
